crossRefs.note: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.
Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba…

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.
